brief.claim: Scores on the task and on the symptom scale are more strongly related in group A than in group B: the Pearson correlation between task score and symptom score is higher in group A than in group B, and a Fisher z test of the difference between the two correlations gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: score of each participant on the experimental task
score of each participant on the symptom questionnaire
whether the participant belongs to group A (true) or group B (false)

brief.sizes: participants = 40 (each of the three keys: 40 values)
